source_analysis.skill: Identify which of four displayed numbers satisfy a scripted special set: intersect numerical class (integer/rational/real), sign, and zero inclusion.
reasoning_steps: Decode base letter Z/Q/R, superscript sign, and subscript 0.
Simplify simple square roots and fractions enough to determine integer/rational/real status; pi and nonsquare roots are irrational.
Apply class and sign/zero tests separately to each displayed candidate.
Select all qualifying checkbox fields, using None of the above only for empty membership, or select the radio choice naming the complete qualifying Roman-label subset.
invariants: Four simple real-number candidates; same elementary class/sign/zero membership decision and easy workload.
Preserve checkbox and radio source families and their complete response banks on replay.
The set definition determines membership independently of candidate location and superficial representation.
Zero belongs exactly when subscript 0 includes it.
permitted_variations: Target among lesson-supported scripted integer/rational/real sets, keeping elementary real candidates and response format.
Vary sign, rationality, integer status, zero presence, roots/fractions/integers/terminating decimals/pi, and their displayed positions.

Vary qualifying candidate identities and qualifying count, including none and all when supported by independent per-candidate membership. Source-specific masks are incidental assignments, not necessary constraints.
Change target while holding candidate list fixed; change candidate class/sign while retaining target; reorder candidates without changing underlying member values.
